description: Election Commission - Notify the Revision of Electoral Registers - 2018
reasoning: This gazette content pertains specifically to electoral processes, specifically the revision of electoral registers for the Colombo and Gampaha electoral districts. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) as it deals with voter registration matters and electoral administration.
